params.name: package
params.description: The name of the Python package to retrieve download statistics for.

params.name: period
params.description: Filter to a specific time period. If omitted, returns all three periods.

items.docs: Retrieves the aggregate download quantities for the last day, last week, and last month for the specified package. This provides a quick overview of recent download activity without a full time series.

params.name: package
params.description: The name of the Python package to retrieve download statistics for.

params.name: mirrors
params.description: Filter by whether downloads from known mirrors are included. Use true to include only mirror downloads, false to exclude them.

items.docs: Retrieves the aggregate daily download time series for the specified package, with or without mirror downloads included. Time series data is retained for 180 days.

info.name: Get downloads by Python major version

params.name: package
params.description: The name of the Python package to retrieve download statistics for.

params.name: version
params.description: Filter to a specific Python major version. If omitted, returns all versions including null.

items.docs: Retrieves the aggregate daily download time series broken down by Python major version number (e.g., 2 or 3). Time series data is retained for 180 days.

info.name: Get downloads by Python minor version

params.name: package
params.description: The name of the Python package to retrieve download statistics for.

params.name: version
params.description: Filter to a specific Python minor version. If omitted, returns all versions including null.

items.docs: Retrieves the aggregate daily download time series broken down by Python minor version number (e.g., 2.7 or 3.11). Time series data is retained for 180 days.

params.name: package
params.description: The name of the Python package to retrieve download statistics for.

params.name: os
params.description: Filter to a specific operating system. If omitted, returns all operating systems including null.

items.docs: Retrieves the aggregate daily download time series broken down by operating system (Windows, Linux, Darwin, or other). Time series data is retained for 180 days.
